description:
Find screens by design problem and keyword, e.g. "pricing page like Stripe", "settings",
"empty project list". Every screen is tagged on four facets: task, pattern (screen archetype),
component and state. Commas mean OR within a facet, facets combine with AND, e.g.
pattern=list-view,table-view and state=empty; ids, labels or aliases work ("kanban", "zero
state"); list_tags has the vocabulary.

q matches titles, tags, visual style (dark, serif, editorial, gradient, playful, pastel...), notes, sections and actions; a word that names a tag ranks screens with
that tag first. Screens matching more words rank higher; partial=true says none matched all,
and a mistyped word is corrected (didYouMean). Each row has productName, captured date and the
page url to cite. Results come 10 at a time (offset for more); fields=brief gives one line each.
Near-duplicates (the same capture twice, a dark-theme copy) show once with the other ids in variants.

Over MCP a small thumbnail of the top result is attached (720 px JPEG, fields=full); images=1 to 3
attaches 1x screenshots instead, images=0 none. Then look before building: get_screen_image for
the 1x image of your picks, or build_recipe with 2 to 6 ids to get them as 1x images with
measurements in one brief. The next field names the exact call.

component.description: Building blocks on the screen, comma-separated for any of them, e.g. modal, date-picker, comparison-table.

fields.description: brief gives one line per screen, without notes and tags.

images.description: How many of the top results' 1x screenshots to attach, 0 to 3. Unset, fields=full attaches one small thumbnail (720 px wide, about 18 KB) and fields=brief none; 0 attaches none.

kind.description: Only return this kind of screen.

offset.description: Results to skip; pass nextOffset from the previous page.

pattern.description: Screen archetype, comma-separated for any of them, e.g. pricing-page, list-view, board-view, settings.

product.description: Only return screens from this product id, e.g. linear, stripe, airbnb.

q.description: Keywords, e.g. "pricing page", "empty state", "dark settings", "serif editorial landing". Omit to list everything that matches the filters.

scope.description: Only screens from collections with this capture scope.

state.description: Data or interaction state, comma-separated for any of them, e.g. empty, first-run, filtered, error.

task.description: What the person is trying to do, comma-separated for any of them, e.g. create, choose-plan, invite.
